chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated: Musa ibn Ja'far al-Baghdadi narrated, from Muhammad ibn Jumhur, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Whoever says in every day of Sha'ban seventy times: 'I seek forgiveness from Allah, whom there is no god but Him, the Merciful, the Merciful, the Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him,' it will be written for him in the Clear Horizon. He said: I said: And what is the Clear Horizon? He said: A flat ground before the Throne, in which there are rivers, and from two scoops [of water] in them [is given] the number of the stars.

key_terms.الْأُفُقُ الْمُبِينُ: The Clear Horizon (a spiritual realm or record)
key_terms.الْقَدْحَيْنِ: Two scoops/sips (referring to a measure of quantity)
key_terms.شَعْبَان: Sha'ban (the eighth month of the Islamic lunar calendar)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting the specific Istighfar supplication seventy times daily during the month of Sha'ban?
ai.summary: In *Mani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq, linking the spiritual purification of Sha'ban to the cosmic geography of the Hereafter. The 'Clear Horizon' (Al-Ufuq Al-Mubin) is interpreted by Shia scholars as a specific station in the Barzakh or Paradise, where the merit of this istighfar is inscribed, symbolizing the vastness of divine mercy corresponding to the multitude of stars. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on preparing the soul for the month of Ramadan through consistent, quantifiable acts of repentance.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, that he said: We were told by Musa bin Ja’far al-Baghdadi, from Muhammed bin Jumhour, from Abdullah bin Abdul-Rahman, from Muhammed bin Abi Hamza, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:

The one who says on every day of Sha’ban seventy times: «I seek forgiveness from Allah, whom there is no god but Him, the Merciful to all, the Mercifull in particular, the Living, the Superb Sustainer, and I repent to Him» it will be written for him in the clear horizon. He said: I said: And what is the clear horizon? He said: Flat ground between the hands of the Throne, in which there are rivers with consistent shares of wealth by the amount of the stars.
